text:
Leah: Need help  candidate accepted but wants $8k relocation + $6k sign-on. L5 band sign-on cap is $10k, relocation usually handled separately. Can we approve combined exception?

Sam (Recruiter): Candidate signed at 10:04. Wants to start 2025-06-02 because of lease timing. Manager prefers earlier as ramp overlaps product freeze window.

Marco: Clarify asks: 1) permit $6k sign-on (over $10k total when combined with relocation), 2) allow relocation stipend to be paid upfront. We usually cap total onboarding spend to $10k per band.

Ravi: Payroll/Finance note  relocation is billed to relocation budget code, sign-on to compensation code. If combined exceeds internal threshold of $10k, policy requires Comp Committee + Finance approval. Relocation paid as reimbursement vs taxable payment depending on structure; need form.

Sam (Recruiter): Quick comp stub:
```
Base: $150,000
Level: L5
Sign-on requested: $6,000
Relocation stipend: $8,000
Total onboarding: $14,000
Start window: prefers 6/2, manager requests 5/19
Justification: critical headcount for release rotation; candidate constrained by lease but can move earlier if relocation paid upfront
```

People Ops Bot: Routing rule: combined onboarding >$10k routes to Comp Committee + Finance + Relocation Admin. Attach lease proof and signed offer.

Leah: I've uploaded lease note and DocuSign to HR-940. Requesting expedited review because manager wants them before freeze. Recommend tagging as "pilot exception" and requiring repayment clause if candidate leaves within 6 months.

Ravi: Finance can accept split funding: $8k relocation from relocation pool (GL 430-RELOC) and $6k sign-on from hiring team (GL 220-1407). Comp Committee still needs to approve since total cash out >$10k.

Marco: Comp Committee, please review for precedent on combining stipend + sign-on. If approved, add a six-month clawback for the sign-on portion.

People Ops Bot: Comp Committee pinged: @comp-committee. Expected decision today.

Sam (Recruiter): Candidate OK with clawback if that enables earlier start. Will sign addendum via DocuSign if committee approves today.

Leah: Thanks all. I'll update HR-940 with committee decision and finalize start date once confirmed.
